You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From b08abbd9f5996309f021684f9ca74da30dcca36a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Quinn Tran <quinn.tran@cavium.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jul 2018 14:29:54 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] scsi: qla2xxx: Fix ISP recovery on unload

During unload process, the chip can encounter problem where a FW dump would
be captured. For this case, the full reset sequence will be skip to bring
the chip back to full operational state.

Fixes: e315cd28b9ef ("[SCSI] qla2xxx: Code changes for qla data structure refactoring")
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: Quinn Tran <quinn.tran@cavium.com>
Signed-off-by: Himanshu Madhani <himanshu.madhani@cavium.com>
Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_os.c b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_os.c
index 2cd2e5ccce15..1fbd16c8c9a7 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_os.c
+++ b/drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_os.c
@@ -6020,8 +6020,9 @@ qla2x00_do_dpc(void *data)
 				set_bit(ISP_ABORT_NEEDED, &base_vha->dpc_flags);
 		}
 
-		if (test_and_clear_bit(ISP_ABORT_NEEDED,
-						&base_vha->dpc_flags)) {
+		if (test_and_clear_bit
+		    (ISP_ABORT_NEEDED, &base_vha->dpc_flags) &&
+		    !test_bit(UNLOADING, &base_vha->dpc_flags)) {
 
 			ql_dbg(ql_dbg_dpc, base_vha, 0x4007,
 			    "ISP abort scheduled.\n");
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/scsi/qla2xxx/qla_os.c`**
- A conditional check was modified in the `qla2x00_do_dpc` function. 
- The original condition that checked if an abort was needed (`ISP_ABORT_NEEDED`) was updated to include an additional check to ensure that the system is not in the process of unloading (`!test_bit(UNLOADING, &base_vha->dpc_flags)`).
- This change prevents the execution of the abort sequence during the unload process, allowing the firmware dump to be captured without skipping the full reset sequence.

### Relationships Between Modifications
- The modification in the `qla_os.c` file directly addresses a bug related to the handling of the unload process in the SCSI driver for qla2xxx. 
- By adding the check for the `UNLOADING` state, the patch ensures that the driver can properly manage the state of the chip during unload, thereby improving the recovery process and preventing potential issues that could arise from an abort being scheduled while unloading. 
- This change is part of a broader effort to enhance the stability and reliability of the driver, as indicated by the fix reference to a previous commit related to data structure refactoring.
